key.name: enable-clipboard
key.description: When false, no clipboard signal is connected and no history is kept.

key.name: shortcut-clipboard
key.summary: Accelerator opening the popup in clipboard mode
key.description: Empty string disables the accelerator. Presets carry a conflict report, never a silent takeover.

key.name: shortcut-emoji
key.summary: Accelerator opening the popup in emoji mode

key.name: text-cap-kb
key.summary: Per-item text capture cap in KiB

key.name: emoji-tone
key.description: Indexes the five Unicode skin-tone modifiers U+1F3FB..U+1F3FF. The range used to stop at 4, so the darkest modifier could never be stored and Preferences' "Dark" row silently did nothing.

key.name: emoji-auto-insert
key.summary: Clicking an emoji inserts at the cursor
key.description: Guarded: refused when the focus target changed since the popup opened; falls back to copy.

key.name: emoji-recents
key.summary: Emoji use counts, keyed by hex codepoint

key.name: enable-ocr
key.description: Capture text from a screen region. Requires tesseract-ocr installed; everything runs locally.

key.name: compact-picker
key.description: Smaller list-only panel without the keycap footer.

key.name: enable-image-capture
key.description: Memory-only, up to 8 MB per clip. Thumbnails and image paste.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.summary: Apps whose clips are never recorded
key.description: Case-insensitive substrings matched against the copy source app name.

key.name: persist-history
key.description: Opt-in. Saves text history to ~/.config/cliplet/history.json. Possible secrets and images are never saved; turning this off deletes the file.

key.name: popup-x
key.description: -1 places the popup automatically (near the pointer).

key.name: released-bindings
key.summary: Custom shortcuts Cliplet released to take an accelerator
key.description: Pairs of (dconf path, previous binding). Custom keybindings Cliplet explicitly took over are kept here so Preferences can put them back untouched.
